import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf, sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1])
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
w['prod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
print(w.late.value_counts())
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late))
print(pd.crosstab(w.date_confidence,w.late,normalize='index'))
print(pd.crosstab(w.origin,w.late,normalize='index'))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','prod']].mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
    return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
def boot(d,B=1000):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0); out=[]
    gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
    for _ in range(B):
        bb=pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])
        out.append(est(bb)[0])
    return np.percentile(out,[2.5,97.5])
e,g=est(w); print(g); print('all',e,boot(w))
h=w[w.date_confidence=='high']; print('high',est(h)[0],boot(h,500))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o, est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
m=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(prod)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(w[(w.late==1)&(w[c]>0)].sample(3,random_state=1).passage_ids
